research_notes: Follow up family-business legal identities and commencement/management handover dates, QGC pipeline payroll employer and hours, Xstrata Wandoan contract dates, early station/timber employers and any paid work during the March–May 2022 parliamentary gap. Full-time status remains unverified throughout.

The 1990 earthmoving start does not mean Xstrata employed him continuously from 1990. Rural Land Development may describe activity rather than a legal entity. QGC is identified as project client, not automatically employer. State-forest location does not imply public employment.

Do not add farm, engineering, earthmoving and gas-project ranges without resolving shared business entities and overlapping hours. APH's undated small-business-owner label is represented by the named types of enterprises, not duplicated as an extra job.

Interests transcription supplies leads CE & TS Boyce, CE & TS Boyce Family Trust and Everest Earthmoving Pty Ltd, but original register and historical company/partnership records need review before attributing old employment to these entities. Financial interests alone are not counted as work.

Searched federal/state biographies, 2018 and 2022 maiden speeches, later apprenticeship speech, party/member biographies, employer/client and company-name searches, parliamentary record, interests transcription and full-time terms. Retrieved 2018 speech and Queensland record materially expand the official occupation summary; no reliable hours or complete earlier employer chronology found. Last follow-up 2026-09-29.

2026-10-02 follow-up materially strengthens business-entity linkage with original indexed state2020 and federal2022 declarations, replacing reliance solely on2025 transcription. Full records not inspectable after403/restricted responses; no access bypass. State2018/2021 registers also surfaced as historical leads, not read. Searches of pipeline-employer names and Everest history yielded no attributable payroll/hours evidence. Farm/engineering/earthmoving may be shared trust/partnership activities; ownership is not continuous employment. Next leads:2018 original register, historical Everest contracts, QGC subcontractor personnel records and named rural-fire brigade. Existing sectors/totals unchanged.

2026-10-03 follow-up: primary Queensland parliamentary inquiry submission explicitly resolves Rural Fire Brigade service as volunteer activity and adds a volunteer Taroom Kindergarten fundraising-coordinator role. Brigade identity and dates remain unknown. Fresh Everest, CE & TS Boyce, QGC-pipeline employer and brigade searches found no attributable payroll, contract, hours or commencement evidence; a 2026 press profile only repeated existing welding/farming facts. Business employment boundaries and all headline hours remain unresolved; blocked status and null totals retained.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Primary2019 speech narrows brigade first-officer cessation to recently before27November2019; exact boundary retained unknown. Primary2023 speech supplies later active-business-partner snapshot despite sons management handover; no personal paid duties or hours inferred.2018 speech re-read supports ringer/shearer work but not unpaid status, correcting category to unknown. Everest/CE&TS/QGC employer and brigade identity searches found no attributable payroll, full-time, contract or leave evidence. All226 members now have an initial durable record and October4follow-up; none meets full specification. Next pass must use new recorded leads and least-recent follow-up chronology across all13batches, avoiding repeated exhausted general queries.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Targeted QGC welding employer/subcontractor, Everest historical corporate registry and rural-fire brigade identity. Own/party biographies repeat project client and business facts without payroll employer/hours.2019 state interests report index surfaced an earlier Everest trustee lead (https://www.parliament.qld.gov.au/Work-of-the-Assembly/Tabled-Papers/redirect/docs/2019/5619T1319.pdf), but direct open403 and individual entry not inspected; retain as lead, no earlier appointment boundary inferred. UK company-control cessation namesake and generic gas-project contractors not assigned to him. Normalised pre-existing volunteer employment_status enum for Kindergarten role to approved unknown while retaining explicit volunteer category/evidence, with no material career claim. Need readable original declaration or individual contracts/service records for further progress.
